column2: (8) Within thirty five days of receiving the report under

column2: (9)  The  Minister  shall  when  advising  the  Commission

column1: under subsection (8), state his or her reasons for his or her

column2: (10) The Commission shall send a copy of the Minister’s

column1: advice  to  the  licensee  to  whom  it  relates  and  publish  the

the advice to the attention of persons likely to be affected by
it. As soon as practicable after making modifications under
this  section,  the  Commission  shall  send  a  copy  of  the
modifications to the licensee and to the Minister.

column2: (11)  (a)  A  licensee  shall  have  a    right  of  appeal  to  the

column2: (b) The Supreme Court Rules relating to appeals to the
